thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: runtime queue depth spiking in us-west-2 (hosted-api). 5% increase in 5xxs, elevated tail latency. Paging on-call @tamara.k @ryan

 tamara.k: ack, I'm on it. hitting dashboards now -> https://dash.redwood/rt/us-west-2/queue-depth

 ryan: I see concurrent_inflight hitting 95% of limit on pool gpu-x1. logs show repeated "max_inflight_reached" messages.

 mike.l: looks like a traffic burst from a customer cohort. Suggest immediate shedding for free-tier and bump max_inflight for dedicated pools as quick mitigation.

 anya: agree. can we toggle shedding flag first? that's the lowest-risk path.

 tamara.k: running opt command to enable shedding for low-priority routes
```bash
# enable soft-shedding for low-priority
rctl runtime update-config --region us-west-2 --set \"shedding.low_priority.enabled=true\"
``` 

 incident-bot: ACTION LOG: shedding.low_priority.enabled=true (tamara.k)

 sara.ops: started applying soft-shed. also increasing max_inflight on pool gpu-x1 from 24 -> 30 for 5m window to absorb ongoing requests.

 tamara.k: patching runtime config
```bash
curl -X PATCH https://ops-api.internal/v1/runtime/config \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN\" \
  -d '{\"pool\": \"gpu-x1\", \"max_inflight\": 30, \"ttl\": 300}'
``` 

 incident-bot: CONFIG UPDATE: pool gpu-x1 max_inflight=30 ttl=300 (sara.ops)

 ryan: after shedding + bump: 5xxs down from 5% -> 1.2%, queue depth trending down. tail latency still elevated ~p99=1.2s.

 mike.l: good. any high-value customers seeing impact? we should check AcmeCorp and BetaApp.

 anya: AcmeCorp spike in 502s initially but errors dropped after shedding. BetaApp still showing increased latencies but not errors.

 tamara.k: opened customer-facing note (internal): \"AcmeCorp: transient errors during mitigation window; no data loss. Follow-up with SEs.\" tagging CSMs.

 sara.ops: quick safety: extend soft-shed rollout to all regions for low-priority if trend continues. we should avoid hard-shedding unless errors climb.

 ryan: curious root cause: lots of long-running requests holding kv-cache and blocking slots. can we enable per-request timeouts to reduce head-of-line? maybe lower idle_timeout for streaming RPCs.

 mike.l: agree, propose lowering streaming idle timeout from 30s -> 12s for low-priority. I'll draft patch.

 mike.l: applying streaming timeout patch for low-priority
```json
{ \"route_selector\": \"priority:low\", \"streaming_idle_timeout_ms\": 12000 }
```

 incident-bot: RUNTIME CHANGE: streaming_idle_timeout_ms=12000 for priority:low (mike.l)

 tamara.k: monitoring after both changes. queue depth continuing to fall. p95 latency back to baseline, p99 improving.

 anya: still seeing a handful of longer KV-lock errors; recommend enabling prefix-cache hit bypass for small requests to reduce lock contention.

 ryan: low-risk toggle: prefix-cache bypass enabled for requests < 512 tokens

 sara.ops: applied prefix-cache bypass; logs show decreased KV contention.

 tamara.k: good. I'm going to notify next on-call for handoff in 15m: @michael-oncall

 michael-oncall: taking handoff in 15. what's the rollback plan if things regress?

 tamara.k: rollback plan summary:
- revert shedding flag: rctl runtime update-config --set \"shedding.low_priority.enabled=false\"
- reset max_inflight on gpu-x1 to 24
- restore streaming_idle_timeout to 30000ms
- revert prefix-cache bypass
All changes are tagged and can be reverted via ops-api. I placed runbooks in the thread.

 michael-oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep an eye for the next 1h and escalate if upward trend resumes.

 anya: created follow-up ticket INF-4621: investigate long-tail requests and per-tenant quotas. assigning to eng-runtime.

 tamara.k: final status update: mitigation actions (soft-shedding, temp max_inflight bump, streaming timeout reduction, prefix-cache bypass) restored service health. Customer impact: transient errors for a small set of free-tier requests and short latency blips for some customers; no persistent data loss. Closing active pager.

 incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: status->mitigated by live traffic changes. tags: runtime, queueing, shedding. Incident duration ~ 24m.

 michael-oncall: taking over monitoring, will coordinate postmortem with eng-runtime tomorrow.

 tamara.k: thanks team :heart: Please add any residual notes to INF-4621.
